exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Lines: 16 lines a part at 2 addresses give 32, under 33 (round 1 readings)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The 33 comes from Pins.md I/O expanders, which counts two expander inputs for the DC input's source status and brownout 'until a decision lets one signal serve both'. V271 and V276 (owner, 2026-10-01) make that decision: one signal, the DC input voltage through a divider into one ADC input of the measurement coprocessor (GPIO 40 to 47), serving both. The expander then carries 31 lines: 20 port enables, 5 bias selectors (R4's SN74LVC1G126DBVR is driven by a line), 5 converter enables, 1 hardware latch read-back; V316 removed the clamp threshold-select lines. 32 lines are at least 31. The page does not pin the four rail latches' read-back for V283's firmware report; if they took expander lines the count would be 35, so the finding assumes they do not. The datasheets pass the other values. TCA6416A (SCPS205, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tca6416a.pdf, read 2026-10-03T01:00:26Z): active-low RESET returns the registers to default, all 16 P-ports are inputs at power-on and after reset, no internal P-port pull-up, 400 kHz, address 0x20 or 0x21 by ADDR (clear of 0x31, 0x40 to 0x4F, 0x18 to 0x1F and 74h/75h), push-pull outputs that source 10 mA. PCAL6416A (https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/data-sheet/PCAL6416A.pdf, read 2026-10-03T01:13:58Z): 'All I/Os are set to inputs at reset', registers return to default on power-up or reset, same 0x20 or 0x21. JLCPCB need is 2 parts x 5 boards = 10, gate 50: TCA6416APWR C130203 2526/2361, TCA6416ARTWR C182336 12685/12614 (2026-10-03T01:00:35Z and :37Z), PCAL6416AHF,128 C2652287 20572/20503 (2026-10-03T01:00:37Z), all expand. Digi-Key (2026-10-03): TCA6416APWR Active, stock 11812, 20 weeks (01:10:09Z); TCA6416ARTWR Active, stock 0, 20 weeks (01:10:11Z); PCAL6416AHF,128 Active, stock 111866, 30 weeks (01:10:13Z). TCAL6416PWR (JLCPCB C20345827 106/106) is left out of this finding: its feature text says RESET re-initialises the bus 'without resetting the sticky registers' while section 7.3.5 says the registers return to default, a conflict not resolved here.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: response: slew 0.16 V/us takes about 16 us to a 2.5 V gate threshold (OPA333 SBOS351E); FU-2H drop, the same reason under V316
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The Servo rail clamp function states no response-time value: V316 asks for the margin to the ceiling, the turn-off signal and its time, and the clamp switch's response is 'reported' (Servo rail clamp switch). A speed that is stated nowhere is not a requirement value, and OPA376's 2 V/us (about 6 us to the same threshold) is equally unstated. Against the stated values both parts pass with less offset error than OPA376AIDBVR, so P2's 'smallest offset error' for rank 1 is not right. OPA333 (SBOS351, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/opa333.pdf, read 2026-10-03T01:02:25Z): VOS 10 uV max at 5 V, drift 0.05 uV/degC max, CMRR 106 dB min, input range (V-) - 0.1 to (V+) + 0.1 V (the 3.56 V divided input is inside), 1.8 to 5.5 V supply, -40 to 125 degC. TLV333 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv333.pdf, read 2026-10-03T01:02:39Z): VOS 15 uV max, drift 0.02 uV/degC typical only, CMRR 102 dB min, same input range. Through P2's own error model (scratch/FU-2I/P2-R6/model/clamp.py with only the op-amp row changed: VOS plus 25 K of drift, CMRR at VCM 3.56 V) the highest thresholds are 8.659 V at the 8.53 V set point (41 mV under 8.70 V, against 38 mV for OPA376) and 5.710 V at 5.59 V (30 mV under the LV ceiling's lowest trip edge 5.740 V, against 28 mV), and the lowest threshold stays above the converter's output at both settings and at 0.8 V. JLCPCB OPA333AIDBVR C30878 stockCount 9003, canPresaleNumber 8249 (2026-10-03T01:11:04Z); TLV333IDBVR C473369 28373/27159 (01:11:06Z); both expand, gate 100 (4 x 5 boards x 5). Digi-Key OPA333AIDBVR, Texas Instruments product: Active, stock 3416, lead 20 weeks (2026-10-03T01:11:12Z; a UMW product shares the number, stock 0); TLV333IDBVR Active, stock 20764, 20 weeks (cached reading 2026-10-03T00:19:34Z). https://www.ti.com/product/OPA333 and /TLV333 meta status ACTIVE (2026-10-03T01:11:25Z). SOT-23-5, the pinout of OPA376AIDBVR, so each is a pin-compatible second source for rank 1 and for the other with Digi-Key stock, which OPA376 lacks. Slew 0.16 V/us and GBW 350 kHz are recorded as the response, not as a limit.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: not dropped for a value: R3's reset supervisor (window, 7 to 13 ms); not among the two recorded, since its overvoltage side also asserts RESET
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The requirement states the falling threshold band and the supply; it forbids no assertion at overvoltage. The overvoltage threshold is 3.3 V x 1.07 less 0.7 %, at least 3.506 V, above the rail's 3.399 V, so RESET does not assert in range, and above it an asserted RESET sets the latch and switches the rails off, the safe direction. TPS3703-Q1 (SBVS344D, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps3703-q1.pdf, read 2026-10-03T01:13:25Z; the non-Q1 SBVS249B has the same table): UV/OV 7 %, accuracy +/-0.7 %, so UV falls at 3.048 to 3.090 V and releases by 3.115 V (under 3.201 V, above 1.65 V); open-drain active-low RESET, VPOR 1 V maximum; VDD 1.7 to 5.5 V; delay with CT open 7 to 13 ms (reported). JLCPCB C1849519 stockCount 307, canPresaleNumber 306 (2026-10-03T01:13:06Z), gate 100; Digi-Key Active, stock 280, 26 weeks (01:13:11Z), also over 100; https://www.ti.com/product/TPS3703-Q1 meta status ACTIVE (01:13:17Z). exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Gate drive within the MOSFET ratings: VVDRV_H 9.4 V min, 10.2 V typ, 11 V max against the 10 V at which the pairs' RDS(on) is stated (TPSI3050, FU-2H re-rank drop)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: 10 V is the condition of a MOSFET table, and the page's value is the 570 mV drop at 3.0 A. DMG4822SSD-13 states RDS(on) at 4.5 V as well (31 mOhm max, 186 mV a pair at 3.0 A) and IRF7313TRPBF states 46 mOhm max at 4.5 V (276 mV), so a 9.4 V drive meets the drop with both; only BUK7K6R8-40E states 10 V alone. FU-2H's re-rank made the same arithmetic and kept the 10 V as the function's value; the drop therefore stands only for that pair, and relaxing it is a decision the page does not record. TPSI3050 (SLVSGO9C, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpsi3050.pdf, read 2026-10-03T01:02:09Z): VDRV 9.4 to 11 V (12 V absolute maximum, under the pairs' 20 V rating), VDDP 3.0 to 5.5 V, EN threshold 0.7 x VDDP (2.31 V at 3.3 V), VDRV fall 2.4 us typ, same pins as TPSI3052.
